Ticket #19 — Parking Permit Management

Difficulty: Easy

Context

You maintain a city's parking-permit ledger. Each zone has a quota of permits active on a requested day. Days are integers. A permit's expires_day is inclusive: a permit expiring on day 3 is valid on day 3 and expired on day 4, even if the expiration sweep has not updated its stored active flag yet.

Practice report

Issue permit a in north on day 1 with duration 1. Its expiration is day 1. Skip the expiration sweep and request renew("a", 2, 5) through the route adapter.

Observation Current starter Expected
Renewal status 200 409
Stored expiration day 6 1

The request must not revive a permit whose inclusive term has ended.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Issuance requires valid IDs, a known zone, integer day and positive integer duration, and a new permit ID. Rejected issuance consumes no quota.
  • Zone quota counts only permits with an active flag and an expiration on or after the requested day. Inactive or expired permits free quota.
  • A new term of duration d starting on day t expires on t + d - 1.
  • An active, unexpired permit can be extended, including on its final valid day. Extension adds the requested duration after its existing term and never shortens it. For a permit ending day 3, renewal on day 2 for 2 days ends day 5.
  • Reject renewal after expiry or when the permit is inactive, unknown, or the renewal input is invalid; preserve its original expiration and ledger state.
  • The expiration sweep marks active permits expired only after their final valid day and returns newly changed IDs. Repeating it has no further effects.
  • Issuance and renewal preserve the per-zone quota invariant.

Out of Scope

Keep integer day numbering and the existing inactive flag for revocation. Calendar/time-zone conversion, payments, and a new revocation API are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Reproduce renewal without the sweep, then compare the inclusive final day with the next day. Add tests for quota availability, term extension, invalid renewal, and a repeated sweep. Assert both returned results and unchanged state after rejection.
